seoTitle: How to Export an Asana Gantt Chart Easily
metaDescription: Learn how to export your Asana Timeline as a CSV file or printable PDF in 2026, plus share live view-only links with clients who don't use Asana.
intro: Asana's Timeline view is its version of a Gantt chart, and there's no single export button that produces a polished PDF automatically, so this guide covers the practical workarounds. You'll learn how to pull raw schedule data as CSV, print the visual chart to PDF, and share a live view-only link with stakeholders instead.

steps.heading: Switch to the Timeline view
steps.body: Open your Asana project and switch to the horizontal Timeline view tab to see the Gantt-style layout.

steps.heading: Export raw data as CSV
steps.body: Open the project actions dropdown menu and use Sync/Export to download your schedule data as a standard CSV file for use in spreadsheets.

steps.heading: Prepare the visual chart for printing
steps.body: Adjust date zoom filters on the Timeline so the chart fits cleanly before triggering your browser's print function.

steps.heading: Print to PDF with the right layout
steps.body: Use your browser's print dialog to save the chart as a PDF, setting landscape orientation and adjusting scale to avoid cutting off timeline bars.

steps.heading: Share a live view-only link
steps.body: Generate a shareable, view-only link so external stakeholders can see the current Timeline without needing an Asana account.

faq.question: Is there a native one-click PDF export for the Timeline view?
faq.answer: No, Asana doesn't offer a direct PDF export button for Timeline, so printing the browser view to PDF is the standard workaround.

faq.question: Can I edit the CSV export in Excel or Google Sheets?
faq.answer: Yes, the exported CSV contains your raw schedule data and opens cleanly in either spreadsheet tool for further analysis.

faq.question: Why does my printed Gantt chart get cut off?
faq.answer: This usually happens when the print layout is set to portrait or the scale is too large, so switch to landscape and adjust the scale before printing.

faq.question: Do external stakeholders need an Asana account to view a shared timeline link?
faq.answer: No, a view-only shareable link lets people see the live Timeline without creating or logging into an Asana account.
